purposeHints.development: Work in progress. Password on every site, hidden from search engines.
purposeHints.staging: A rehearsal before release. Password on every site, hidden from search engines.
purposeHints.production: Live for everyone. Sites are public and meant to be indexed.

indicator.summaryGap: {{purpose}}: only {{protected}} of {{total}} domains protected. Something is open.
indicator.summaryLocked: {{purpose}}: no credentials, so every site is locked.

firstUse.title: What is this server for?
firstUse.description: Opsifier protects every site on this server until you say otherwise.
firstUse.meanwhile: Until you choose, every site asks for a password and stays out of search engines.

credentialsOnce.title: New credentials
credentialsOnce.warning: Copy this now. It will not be shown again.

toProduction.title: Move to production?
toProduction.description_one: {{count}} domain will become public, with no password, and open to indexing.
toProduction.description_other: {{count}} domains will become public, with no password, and open to indexing.

leaveProduction.title: Protect this server?
leaveProduction.description: Every site will ask for a password and be hidden from search engines, starting now. New purpose: {{purpose}}.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: What this server is for decides how every site on it is exposed.
purpose.unset: No purpose chosen yet. The server behaves as non-production: protected.
purpose.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change this.

protection.title: Protection
protection.description: Read back from what the proxy holds, not from what was asked of it.
protection.descriptionProduction: A production server is public by design: nothing here is protected.

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.description: Sites you add will be protected as soon as they exist.

problems.no_credentials: There are no credentials, so every site is locked. Add a user below.
problems.panel_exposed: The panel's own pages are missing their robots rules.
problems.unreadable_file: The routing file {{file}} could not be read.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: One set for the whole server. Passwords are stored as hashes and shown once, when generated.
credentials.passwordHint: Leave empty to generate a strong one.
credentials.rotateDescription: The current password for {{username}} stops working at once.
credentials.removeDescription: {{username}} can no longer get through. A protected server always keeps one user.

empty.title: No credentials yet
empty.description: They are generated the moment this server gets a protected purpose.

credentials.usernameHint: Every protected site asks for it.

allowlist.title: Exemptions
allowlist.description: Paths or address ranges of one service that may skip the password, for callbacks and health checks.
allowlist.warning: Each exemption is a way around the password. Keep them few and narrow.
allowlist.pathHint: Exactly this path, or everything under it with /hooks/*.
allowlist.ipHint: One address, or a range such as 203.0.113.0/24.
allowlist.removeDescription: {{value}} will ask for the password again.
allowlist.kindHint: By path, or by the visitor's address.
allowlist.serviceHint: The service that skips the password.

certificates.title: Hostnames in logs
certificates.description: Certificates leave a public trace, even for a protected site.
certificates.advice: Certificates from a public authority are written to public Certificate Transparency logs, so a hostname on this server can be discovered even while it is protected. A wildcard certificate would keep each hostname out of the logs, but HTTPS on a wildcard has not been verified on this panel yet.

errors.username: Use letters, digits, dots, dashes, underscores and @, up to 64 characters.
errors.password: Use at least 12 characters, and no more than 72 bytes.
errors.path: Enter a path such as /healthz, or /hooks/* for everything under it.
errors.ip: Enter an address or a range such as 203.0.113.0/24, no wider than /8.
